newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN LEV CLOSES FLAT VS MARK, DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN LEV CLOSES FLAT VS MARK, DOLLAR.

text.p: The lev closed at 995-996 per mark, in a narrower spread from the opening's 994.50-996 due to a technical correction after a calm domestic interbank trade, dealers said.
* Spot dollar ended flat at 1,854-1,858 levs as traders adjusted exchange rates througn the domestic lev/mark and the mark/dollar cross on global markets.
* Under a currency board system, a form of an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism, the lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor in the system since July 1.
* The central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at a bid of 995 levs and ask of 1,000 levs under the currency board. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
